materials.name: ochre-rock
materials.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: seamless square tileable base-color/albedo texture for a real-time 3D fantasy game's triplanar terrain, NOT a scene or material-ball preview. Full-bleed orthographic surface scanned straight on, uniform diffuse illumination, no baked directional shadows, no vignette, no perspective, no borders, text, labels, objects or sky. Opposite edges must tile seamlessly. Paperback Sanctum art direction: aged pre-digital fantasy illustration translated into tangible 3D materials, mellow local colors, broad quiet painted color grouping, selective restrained descriptive marks, economical detail, serious dreamy harsh wilderness. Retro 1990s/2000s feeling without literal pixel art. Matte color only; no photorealistic microdetail, no harsh black cracks, no glossy highlights. Low contrast at large scale; readable medium-sized shapes rather than high frequency noise. Entire image is ONE material, equally detailed across the tile. Square 1024x1024.
Primary material: Weathered canyon sandstone, mellow ochre, dusty terracotta, warm gray and pale clay. Broad worn stone facets with sparse fine broken fissures; subtle irregular erosion marks in multiple directions, no brick pattern, no stacked horizontal bands, no deep black gaps. Suitable for both cliffs and rocky ground.
